If you can count seconds in your head, pay attention to your right knee and when it comes up, if it comes up more often than your seconds count you're probably over 80 and good, if it's coming up every second or less shift down 1 or 2.

That's for flat ground, for hills you might even shift low enough to have faster than your flat-ground spin rate.
